title: Beverage Regulatory Intelligence Web Product
objective: Deliver an authenticated browser workspace that turns concrete beverage label, ingredient, claim, campaign, supplier, and regulatory-change questions into source-backed research, timelines, alerts, and reconciliation findings without claiming legal approval.

source.notes: The existing research library and regwatch engine are the evidence foundation. Future web, identity, and hosting choices remain decision gates.

problem.statement: Beverage teams cannot reliably connect product decisions to the right CFR text, lifecycle changes, recalls, alerts, and formula-versus-label evidence in a single auditable browser workflow.
evidence: Existing regwatch source monitoring, portfolio, impact, and briefing capabilities

goal.statement: Authorized users can investigate a beverage decision, act on a change or recall, and review a label proof against a versioned formulation with evidence and an explicit escalation boundary.
goal.metric: Evaluation scenarios yield cited results, material unknowns, timeline status, and audit records; no scenario displays an automated compliance approval.
goal.baseline: Research and monitoring are repository and command-line artifacts with no authenticated browser workflow.
goal.target: A hosted, audited browser workflow meeting the readable plan's acceptance criteria.

non_goals: Give legal advice or approve labels.
Expose formula or supplier data publicly.
Automatically promote detections into curated legal facts.
Put credentials or unrestricted fetch tools in the browser.
Adopt data sources, API contracts, or retrieval indexing without verification.
assumptions: The first release is organization-scoped and authenticated.
21 CFR is the deepest corpus, with focused 7 CFR and 16 CFR context.
The research library remains durable even if the web UI is unavailable.
Human reviewers remain responsible for source confirmation and legal escalation.
decisions_needed: Choose identity provider, hosting provider, and private-data retention policy.
Approve the first evaluation scenarios and user roles.
Select official CFR acquisition and current-text retrieval contracts after verification.
Choose alert recipients and delivery channels.
Confirm the retrospective period for recall and enforcement history.
risks: Current regulatory status can change after retrieval.
Formula, supplier, and label-proof data are sensitive.
Product classification and claims can depend on unknown facts.
A broad data or UI build can obscure the defined user workflows.
Source polling failures or retry behavior can cause missed or duplicate alerts.

requirements.statement: Define users, roles, representative workflows, answer packages, and evaluation scenarios before feature implementation.
Provide verified, hierarchy-preserving CFR source records and beverage knowledge for Title 21 with focused Titles 7 and 16 context.
Expose bounded server-side agent tools for CFR research queries with citations, source versions, material unknowns, and legal-review boundaries.
Track proposed and actual regulatory lifecycle events, comment periods, effective and compliance dates, recalls, and alert state without auto-curating legal facts.
Compare a versioned label-proof text with a versioned formula and supplier specification, returning discrepancies and missing inputs without a compliance verdict.
Provide authenticated browser workspaces for search, saved research, research, timelines, alerts, label review, and the research library.
Host the product securely with organization-scoped authorization, audit logs, private storage, server-side credentials, and observable scheduled jobs.
Evaluate end-to-end workflows, publish human and LLM navigation indexes, and roll out only after safety and accuracy gates pass.

tests.expected: Source, node, edge, lifecycle, and alert records are valid and traceable.
A representative authorized user completes each primary browser workflow and can explain result source, status, unknown facts, and next action.
tests.evidence: Dated usability and workflow evaluation record.

tests.expected: A reviewer verifies sampled query answers and knowledge notes against primary records.
tests.evidence: Dated source-review record with prompts, citations, reviewer, and corrections.

tests.expected: Existing regwatch records remain valid while lifecycle and alert extensions pass their fixtures.
Known matches, mismatches, and missing-input cases produce deterministic findings and never an approved/compliant status.
Unauthenticated and cross-organization access is denied, tool credentials are absent from browser responses, and audit events are recorded.
tests.evidence: Staging security-check output and audit-log sample.

prs.title: Product Workflow and Data Contracts
prs.objective: Define roles, evaluation scenarios, evidence-result contract, lifecycle schema, and sensitive product-data contract.
tasks: Define users and permissions.
Write representative research, alert, and reconciliation scenarios.
Define result, lifecycle, formula, supplier, and label-proof contracts.
Record hosting and retention decisions needed.

negative: Scenario that asks for a compliance approval is rejected as an unsupported result type.

acceptance: Every primary workflow has input, output, owner, evidence, and escalation rules.
Missing formula or proof inputs are modeled explicitly.
prs.rollback: Remove new contracts without changing regwatch.

prs.title: Research Library and CFR Agent Query Service
prs.objective: Implement verified CFR source access, beverage knowledge traversal, and bounded server-side query tools.
tasks: Verify official source contracts.
Normalize citation hierarchy.
Create CFR query and source-detail tools.
Add beverage-focused knowledge records.
Return evidence, status, unknown facts, and escalation fields.

preflight: Record source version and retrieval metadata.
negative: Query with an unknown citation does not fabricate text or a citation.

acceptance: A query returns bounded, source-backed evidence with hierarchy and retrieval metadata.
The tool has no browser-exposed fetch credential.
prs.rollback: Disable the adapter and retain durable source snapshots and notes.

prs.title: Regulatory Lifecycle, Recall, and Alert Services
prs.objective: Extend regwatch into explicit lifecycle timelines, recall records, alert routing, and confirmation state.
tasks: Add proposal, comment, final, effective, compliance, implementation, delay, and withdrawal events.
Add recall/action records.
Calculate timelines.
Route and audit alerts.
Preserve manual promotion of legal facts.

preflight: Review lifecycle and recall fixture sources.
negative: Detected source change cannot update a curated obligation without human confirmation.

acceptance: Timeline distinguishes proposed and actual state.
Alerts are deduplicated, assignable, and auditable.
prs.rollback: Pause jobs and alert delivery while retaining source and timeline records.

prs.title: Label Proof and Formulation Reconciliation Service
prs.objective: Store versioned product inputs and compare label-proof text with formulation and supplier evidence.
tasks: Model formula, supplier, and proof versions.
Extract or accept verified proof text.
Compare ingredients, order basis, subingredients, carriers, claims, and missing inputs.
Render discrepancy findings and source links.

preflight: Classify uploaded data sensitivity and access scope.
negative: Engine cannot emit compliant, approved, or safe as an outcome.

acceptance: Known match, mismatch, and missing-input fixtures are deterministic.
Every finding identifies its input versions and evidence.
prs.rollback: Disable reconciliation jobs and preserve versioned inputs read-only.

prs.title: Authenticated Browser Workspace
prs.objective: Build the browser UI for research, timeline, alerts, label review, and library navigation.
tasks: Implement organization-aware navigation.
Build research, timeline, alerts, label-review, and library pages.
Show source, status, uncertainty, and audit metadata.
Handle empty, missing-input, and human-review states.

local: Browser component and API contract tests
negative: Browser cannot access another organization or server-side tool credential.

acceptance: An authorized user completes all five workflows.
No automated result is styled or labeled as approval.
prs.rollback: Disable the web release while preserving APIs and data.

prs.title: Secure Hosted Operations
prs.objective: Deploy the web product with identity, authorization, private storage, auditability, and observable background jobs.
tasks: Select and configure hosting and identity.
Implement organization authorization.
Configure encrypted private storage.
Add audit logging, retries, monitoring, and backups.
Test staging access boundaries.

negative: Unauthenticated and cross-organization requests are denied.
Worker failure is visible and does not silently lose an alert.

acceptance: Browser users are authenticated and organization-scoped.
Credentials remain server-side and audit logs trace sensitive actions.
prs.rollback: Use the documented deployment rollback while preserving immutable audit evidence.

prs.title: End-to-End Evaluation and Rollout
prs.objective: Validate the hosted product against representative workflows, publish navigation indexes, and roll out under explicit safety gates.
tasks: Run workflow and source review.
Audit authorization and alert behavior.
Publish indexes and runbooks.
Set refresh cadence and launch gates.

negative: Any automatic approval wording, source-less finding, or unauthorized access blocks rollout.

acceptance: The product satisfies the planned workflows with evidence and auditability.
Launch is blocked until safety, source, and access gates pass.
prs.rollback: Roll back the web release and pause jobs using the operations runbook.

preflight: Validate this plan and source contracts.
Run regression checks before any data migration or browser deployment.
scheduling: Workers poll approved sources, calculate lifecycle and alert changes, and require human confirmation to curate legal facts.
closeout: Run source review, workflow evaluation, security checks, make test, and deployment health checks before rollout.

features.name: Research library and CFR agent tools

metadata.legal_notice: Internal research only. Not legal advice. A human confirms primary text and product facts before compliance or marketing use.
